profile.account_caption: Your watchlist, portfolio ledger and preferences are attached to this account — other users of this app never see them. Data folder: `{folder}`.
profile.language_caption: Sets the interface language. Auto follows your browser's language; pick one to override it on every device.
profile.currency_caption: The currency the app reckons in: the ledger is replayed in it, each leg at the rate for its own trade date, so the figures are computed in it rather than converted afterwards. The **Realized & tax** tab is the exception — it follows your tax residence below, which is a legal fact rather than a preference.
profile.watchlist_caption: Drives Overview, Screener, Earnings and the ticker picker. Add or remove rows and hit **Save**. `shares` + `cost` make an entry a position for the equal-weight fallback analytics; the real book still comes from imported transactions. Alert rules on kept tickers are preserved. Crypto goes in as a Yahoo pair symbol — `BTC-USD`, `ETH-EUR` — never a bare coin code (bare codes collide with stock tickers).
profile.watchlist_empty: Watchlist is empty — add a row below (**+** at the bottom of the table), type a ticker like `AAPL`, and hit **Save**. Overview, Screener and Earnings come alive as soon as one ticker is in.
profile.col_avg_cost_help: Average buy price per share, in the stock's native currency
profile.col_tags_help: Comma-separated groups, e.g. `semis, EM` — the ticker picker search matches them
profile.iv_caption: Tells the AI assistant who it's advising, so its analysis fits you instead of a generic default. Stored privately with your account and sent as context to the assistant.
profile.iv_notes: Anything else the assistant should know
profile.iv_notes_ph: e.g. saving for a house deposit in 3 years; avoid tobacco and defense; already heavy in semis…
profile.iv_dialog_intro: A few quick questions so the AI assistant tailors its analysis to you. You can skip and fill this in later on the Profile page.
profile.notify_caption: Get a daily portfolio digest and price alerts on Telegram.
profile.tg_not_configured: Telegram notifications aren't configured on this deployment.
profile.tg_how_body:
- **Daily digest** — portfolio value, day and week change, top movers and upcoming earnings, weekday evenings after the US close.
- **Price alerts** — your watchlist thresholds, checked hourly on market days.

Linking takes a few seconds: press **Connect Telegram**, then **Start** in the chat that opens. It works even if you've talked to the bot before — pressing Start again simply links this account. Only your Telegram chat id is stored, and you can disconnect anytime from this tab.
profile.tg_manual: No Start button in Telegram? Send {bot} this message: `/start {code}`
profile.tg_waiting: Waiting for you to press Start in Telegram…
profile.tg_expired: The link expired — generate a new one.
profile.delete_body: Deletes your watchlist, imported transactions, preferences and assistant conversations — locally and in cloud storage. This cannot be undone. Backup snapshots expire on their own (about 30 days).
profile.delete_confirm: I understand this permanently erases all my data.
profile.delete_failed: Deletion failed — nothing was removed. Try again, and contact the operator if it persists.
profile.tax_residence_caption: Picks the rules the **Realized & tax** tab applies and the currency your cost basis is computed in — EUR at the ECB rate of each transaction date for Spain, USD at that date's rate for the US. Auto reads the region from your browser and falls back to Spain.
profile.tax_niit_caption: Adds NIIT above the MAGI threshold ($200,000 single, $250,000 joint). Off by default: it also covers dividends and interest this app doesn't see, so the estimate would be low either way.
profile.tax_filing_status_caption_us: Sets the bracket table, the capital-loss deduction cap ($3,000, or $1,500 filing separately) and the Form 8938 threshold.
profile.tax_filing_status_caption_de: Sets the Sparer-Pauschbetrag: €1,000 alone, €2,000 on a joint return.
profile.tax_church_caption: Charged as a share of the tax itself, not of the income, so 9% turns the 26.375% headline into about 27.99%.
profile.tax_other_income_caption_us: Your other taxable income for the year, **after** deductions. Short-term gains stack on top of it, and it decides which long-term rate band your gains land in. Leave at 0 to see the gains taxed on their own.
profile.tax_other_income_caption_uk: Your other taxable income for the year, **after** the personal allowance. Gains stack on top of it: whatever is left of the £37,700 basic-rate band is taxed at 18%, the rest at 24%.
